description: This file defines a class 'CommonCodecTypeFilter' with a method 'IsAbstractOrFrameworkType' used to filter types based on specific criteria such as being abstract, having certain custom attributes, or belonging to specific frameworks.

classes.name: CommonCodecTypeFilter
classes.description: Provides static methods for filtering types based on whether they are framework or abstract types.

methods.name: IsAbstractOrFrameworkType
methods.description: Determines if a given type is abstract, has the 'GeneratedCode' attribute with 'OrleansCodeGen', or is part of a framework based on 'FrameworkPart' attribute.
